title: Mummy ka "Thoda Sa"
text:
Mummy: Thoda sa aur le lo.
"Thoda sa" = aadhi thali.
Mana karo toh:
"Tumhare liye hi banaya tha."
Emotional damage with extra ghee. 🍛

title: Papa ka Raasta
text:
Google Maps: 25 minute.
Papa: Main ek shortcut jaanta hoon.
55 minute baad.
Papa: Traffic aaj zyada tha.
Shortcut ka blame hamesha traffic pe. 🚗

title: Bhai-Behen ki Ladai
text:
Bhai-behen 10 minute me lad sakte hain,
10 second me shaanti kar sakte hain,
aur agar mummy aa jaaye
toh 1 second me team ban jaate hain. 🤝

title: Dadi aur Smart TV
text:
Dadi: Ye TV band kaise karte hain?
Main: Red button.
Dadi: Do red button hain.
Main: Dono daba do.
Ab TV bhi confuse hai, dadi bhi. 📺

title: Ghar ki Safai
text:
Main: Maine apna kamra saaf kar diya.
Mummy: Almari kholo.
Main: …
Mummy: Yahi socha tha.
Safai nahi thi, sirf relocation tha. 🧹

title: Chacha ji ka Gyaan
text:
Chacha ji: Hamare zamane me 5 rupaye me poora din nikal jaata tha.
Main: Aur aaj 5 rupaye me?
Chacha ji: Aaj 5 rupaye me sirf baat nikal jaati hai. 💰

title: Family Trip Packing
text:
2 din ka trip.
Mummy ka bag: 4 achaar, 3 paratha packet, ek pressure cooker.
Papa: "Hotel me khana milta hai."
Mummy: "Bahar ka khana theek nahi hota." 🧳

title: Papa ki Bachat
text:
Papa AC 26 pe chalate hain
aur fan bhi on rakhte hain,
fir kehte hain: "Bijli bacha rahe hain."
Logic wahi jaanein. ❄️

title: Nani ke Ghar
text:
Nani ke ghar ke 3 rule:
1. Khaana mana nahi kar sakte.
2. Dubara mana nahi kar sakte.
3. Teesri baar toh koshish bhi mat karna. 🥰

title: Cousin Comparison
text:
Har family function me ek cousin hota hai
jiske marks, salary aur height
hamesha aapse behtar hoti hai —
kam se kam story me toh hoti hi hai. 📊

title: Mummy ka Phone
text:
Mummy phone pe 40 minute baat karengi,
aur last me kahengi:
"Chalo rakhti hoon, bill aa jaayega." 📞

title: Plastic Chair
text:
Har Indian ghar me ek plastic ki kursi hoti hai
jo 15 saal purani hai,
tedhi ho chuki hai,
par mehmaan ke liye sabse pehle wahi nikalti hai. 🪑

title: Papa ki Nasihat
text:
Papa kabhi seedha nahi bolte.
Wo TV dekhte hue
hawa me ek line chhod dete hain,
aur wo line agle 3 din tak dimaag me goonjti hai. 🎯

title: Chhota Bhai
text:
Chhote bhai ke paas hamesha
koi na koi information hoti hai
jiski keemat 50 rupaye hoti hai.
Duniya ka sabse chhota blackmailer. 😈

title: Ghar ka Khaana
text:
Ghar pe: "Roz wahi daal-chawal."
Hostel me: "Kaash aaj daal-chawal mil jaata."
Doori se sab kuch swadisht lagta hai. 🍚

title: Mummy So Rahi Hai
text:
Mummy sirf "aankh band" karti hain, sote nahi.
TV ka volume 2 badhao —
turant: "Main dekh rahi thi." 😴
